issues.title: Static definition aliases used in conversion functions emit invalid patient-correlated CTE lookups
evidence: Translated CQL `ToInteger(StringAlias)` where `StringAlias` is `'5'` generated `ToInteger((SELECT sub.value FROM "StringAlias" AS sub WHERE sub.patient_id = _pt.patient_id LIMIT 1))`.

Translated CQL `ToString(RatioAlias)` where `RatioAlias` is `ToRatio('10 ''mg'':2 ''mL''')` generated `RatioToString((SELECT sub.resource FROM "RatioAlias" AS sub WHERE sub.patient_id = _pt.patient_id LIMIT 1))`.
The generated standalone scalar SQL fails with an unbound `_pt` alias even though the source is compile-time static.
resolution: Added static conversion source detection for literal/static definition aliases.
Conversion functions and `convert ... to ...` now inline safe static source definition bodies before SQL generation.
verification: Static alias conversion regression test passed against forced Python fallback and native-loaded C++ registration.
Focused CQL-07 and adjacent parity pytest passed 31/31.
Full fhir4ds pytest passed 7155 with 5 skipped.

issues.title: convert List<Code> to Concept emits an unbindable JSON[] argument
evidence: Translated CQL `convert { Code { code: 'x', system: 's' }, Code { code: 'y', system: 's' } } to Concept` emitted `ToConceptFromList([json_object(...), json_object(...)])`.
DuckDB inferred that list as `JSON[]`, but `ToConceptFromList` is registered as `VARCHAR[]`, producing a BinderException.
resolution: When a statically-known `List<Code>` conversion targets Concept, SQLArray code elements are cast to VARCHAR before calling `ToConceptFromList`.
verification: Direct delegated reproducer now returns `{\"codes\":[{\"code\":\"x\",\"system\":\"s\"},{\"code\":\"y\",\"system\":\"s\"}]}` on both backends.
Focused CQL-07 and adjacent parity pytest passed 31/31.
Full fhir4ds pytest passed 7155 with 5 skipped.
